verse.verse_1: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
verse.verse_2: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
verse.verse_3: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
verse.verse_4: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
verse.verse_5: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
verse.verse_6: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
verse.verse_7: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
verse.verse_8: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
verse.verse_9: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
verse.verse_10: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
verse.verse_11: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
verse.verse_12: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
verse.verse_13: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
verse.verse_14: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
verse.verse_15: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
verse.verse_16: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
verse.verse_17: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
verse.verse_18: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
verse.verse_19: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
verse.verse_20: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
verse.verse_21: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
verse.verse_22: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
verse.verse_23: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;
verse.verse_24: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
verse.verse_25: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
verse.verse_26: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
verse.verse_27: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
verse.verse_28: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
verse.verse_29: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
verse.verse_30: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
verse.verse_31: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
